description: This file contains a shell script that specifies test cases for verifying the behavior of 'git diff' with various options such as -B, -M, and -C. It sets up scenarios with file modifications, renames, and copies, then compares expected diffs to actual outputs to ensure correct functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, sets up environment, runs commands, and compares output with expected.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares actual diff output with expected diff output.
